item.title: Cows stalked and attacked my dog and I, 27th September
item.description:
I was using the public footpath walking my dog this morning. I was walking from harp hill up to dunkertons through northfield farm. I had my dog on a short leash. Slowly walking along the hedge line. A large female cow started to stalk my dog and I when we passed her many metres away. I turned and remained face on with her but she persisted to come closer. I stood my ground but my dog was petrified and started yelping which made the rest of the herd surround us. The cow was literally over my dog and backed us into the hedge. I managed to get my dog through the hedge and over the barbed wire fence. I too managed to clamber over with a few minor cuts and torn clothing. There were also some cows in this other field now alarmed by the herd which started to charge. I started waving my jacket shouting loudly and luckily these fewer cows weren’t charging as aggressively and I managed to back out of the field safely. I think other members of the public should be notified.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
